newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges sideways, paraffinic supply thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges sideways, paraffinic supply thin.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices edged sideways on Wednesday despite weaker crude oil, traders said.
Market talk died early ahead of an industry function in London, and prices may still have some way to fall when trading begins on Thursday.

After two Alexandria and one Bombay cargoes found homes earlier this week, most October shorts were covered, but supply remained tight, especially for paraffinic grades. Algeria's Skikda port remained shut for a second day on Wednesday.
Small parcels of high N+A and full range, from Russia and NWE refiners, were getting snapped up by ARA buyers.
